newsitem.title: CHINA: Shangling offers no dividend for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shangling offers no dividend for 1996.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Shangling Electric Appliances Co have approved the firm's plan to offer no dividend for the 1996 fiscal year, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The plan was proposed by the firm's board of directors after the company posted a net loss for 1996 under international accounting standards, the statement said.

Shangling, a major B share company listed on the Shanghai stock exchange, earlier posted a net loss of 122.34 million yuan in 1996 against a net profit of 143.629 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
The firm said it was mainly hit by fierce competition from home-made and imported electric appliances including refrigerators and air-conditioners.
